project.name: TripThread
project.description: Travel-focused social platform where users create trips, post thread entries (text/media/location/check-ins), and generate/publish final trip posts.
project.lastPRReviewed: PR #48 — Realtime Chat Messaging System: Trip-scoped, 1:1, and group conversations, message editing and soft deletion, participant management, Cloudinary attachments, active typing indicators, and complete Flutter integration.

backend.auth: JWT access + refresh tokens; login supports email OR username
backend.realtime: WebSocket Server (ws on custom server.cjs) + in-process shared event bus
backend.retry: Exponential backoff utility (src/lib/retry.ts) for Cloudinary + Mapbox calls
backend.monitoring: PerformanceMonitor timer instrumentation + ErrorTracker on all API endpoints

mobile.network: Dio with token refresh interceptors + retry with exponential backoff
mobile.svgRendering: flutter_svg for branded TripThread logo assets
mobile.chat: WebSocketChannel real-time sync with ChatSocketService + ChatProvider provider

scheduler.purpose: Auto-transition trip status and auto-finalize ended trips
scheduler.executionModel: Run once per invocation and exit

dockerization.type: Full-stack containerized local environments via Docker Compose
dockerization.entrypoint: scripts/docker-entrypoint.sh resolves DB readiness, runs migrations, starts Next.js
dockerization.hybridMode: docker-compose.dev.yml launches only Postgres containers for host-based Next.js development

notableSchemaTraits: Trip has status lifecycle: UPCOMING -> ONGOING -> ENDED
TripFinalPost is currently 1:1 with Trip (tripId unique) - planned migration to personalized posts per participant (composite unique [tripId, userId])
Engagement counters (likeCount/commentCount/shareCount) are denormalized on entities
Place model supports external IDs and coordinate index
Soft-delete style fields exist on User (deletedAt/deleteMeta)
Media model supports Cloudinary integration with quota tracking
Notification model supports unified notifications (likes, comments, follows, mentions)
Conversation model supports DM, GROUP, and TRIP type rooms with dynamic participants and leftAt validation
ChatMessage model supports content, soft deletion with deletedAt, and message replyTo hierarchy

majorDomains: likes/comments/shares (POST /shares shareSource: SYSTEM_SHEET default, no shareCount bump; IN_APP_DM bumps for future DM)
chat (real-time WebSockets on /chat + REST endpoints under /api/chat)

keyTripFlow.threadEntries: POST /trips/[id]/entries; GET cursor-paginated page { items, hasMoreOlder, nextOlderCursor } (limit default 30); GET /trips/[id]/entries/[entryId]/context returns a centered window around the target entry for deep-link jumps; DELETE/PATCH /trips/[id]/entries/[entryId] (PATCH: author text edit within 15m, owner may moderate later); shared purge in threadEntryPurge.ts
keyTripFlow.participantLeave: POST /trips/[id]/leave { removeMyData: boolean } — non-owner participant leaves; optional purge of author's entries (ONGOING only) now uses bulk cleanup path for scalability
keyTripFlow.endTripAndGenerateFinalPost: POST /trips/[id]/end (transactionally marks ENDED + generates final post)
keyTripFlow.homeFeed: GET /feed/home (published final posts from self, followed users, and public users)

notableBehaviors: Prisma: `PrismaTransactionClient` and `AppPrismaClient` exported for extended client + seed/tooling typing
Test DB safety: `dbUrlSafety.ts` refuses Postgres URLs unless database name ends with `_test`; Vitest/seed/setup-test-db enforce via TEST_DATABASE_URL only
TripFinalizerService builds summary, curates up to 10 images, enforces publish requirements
Comment/Like services create notification records asynchronously (COMMENT_LIKE for comment likes)
Notification service merges follow requests with engagement notifications using opaque cursor pagination
withAuth invalidates tokens issued before user.updatedAt
Rate limits support fixed-window and sliding-window logic (fixed window currently used)
Real-time Chat: uses global.chatEventBus in server.cjs to bridge REST message actions with WebSocket clients
Typing indicators are broadcast in-process to other participants via WebSocket Server

flow: Mobile requests signed params from backend
Backend validates payload/mime/signature constraints and persists Media row
Backend searches via Mapbox Geocode API and deduplicates against local Place DB
Resolve endpoint canonicalizes place rows with caching + lock
Mobile map screen renders trip places with Mapbox map widget

usage: Cache place lookups and search outputs
Fallback-friendly rate limiting and cache metrics

routerHighlights.authRedirectLogic: Redirects unauthenticated users to /login and profile-incomplete users to /complete-profile

jobLogic: End trips where endDate <= now and status in UPCOMING/ONGOING
Generate final posts for ended trips if missing
Start trips where startDate <= now < endDate and status is UPCOMING
scheduler.observedDifferenceVsBackendFinalizer: Scheduler has its own inline final-post generation logic and does not call backend TripFinalizerService directly.
